Text.label:
Instructions
The default cart is the bundle cart. 
To change carts drag the selected cart away from the port and delete all the connections.
Then drag the new cart to where the old cart was.

Controls
The reset button resets the Femto-4.
The power toggle runs the Femto-4. 
The Keyboard is for text inputs, whilst the controllers are for button inputs.
The WASD Pad maps keyboard inputs into controller inputs for both controllers.
The WASD Pad must be enabled using the WASD Pad Enabled Button.
By default it is not selected.
The free buttons labelled "Controller 1 Mappings" and Controller 2 Mappings" show the button mappings of the WASD Pad.
To input into the WASD Pad click on the WASD Pad keyboard.
The keyboard mappings are designed for a British keyboard.
When viewing the project in fullscreen, if entering text kicks you out of fullscreen, re-enter fullscreen, select another subcircuit, 
and then select main again. Entering text into a keyboard should no longer kick you out of fullscreen.
